items.quote: Wir benötigen die Unterlagen spätestens am 7. Arbeitstag nach dem Briefdatum;
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is 30.09.2025 (Tuesday). This is a private deadline set by the insurer counted from the letter date, not a statutory delivery-fiction period, so §187 Abs. 1 BGB applies: the day of the triggering event (30.09.2025) is not counted, counting starts 01.10.2025. The letter defines 'Arbeitstage' itself as Monday–Friday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting business days from 01.10.2025: 01.10 (Wed) = day 1, 02.10 (Thu) = day 2, 03.10 (Fri) is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so it is skipped and not counted, 04.10–05.10 weekend skipped, 06.10 (Mon) = day 4, 07.10 (Tue) = day 5, 08.10 (Wed) = day 6, 09.10 (Thu) = day 7. The 7th business day is therefore 09.10.2025. Since the count already excludes weekends/holidays, no further end-of-period adjustment is needed.
